execution.description: Two miner research tool fixes from the phase-4 session 1 triage: dry_validate answers with the named Challenge's submission compile, and a practice call's action and arguments sent as the string "null" are read as JSON null under a new frozen argument normalisation rule (v2), with a registered correction on every remaining practice refusal at the miner door.

expected: dry_validate tells an agent whether the submission path would accept a recipe, and a model that sends the string "null" for a null field is either understood or told how to fix it.
observed: dry_validate ran only A2's structural check, so it answered valid for kNN neighbours -5, for family settings nested under the family name and for excluded or not-yet-rebuildable fields, all of which the real compile refuses. On practice, the miner door refused action "null" with a bare INVALID_ARGUMENT and no correction text, while the SDK behind it would have named the field and the fix; Graphite's miner path passes action through unchanged, so the model saw no guidance.
keep: A validation tool answers with the same compile the authoritative path runs, with the same typed codes, never a weaker check under the same name.
Tolerance for a model's habit is a new frozen rule version that new plans freeze; the earlier version stays registered so its campaigns replay byte for byte.
A dry run is proved dispatch-free with a spy and an untouched ledger and task store, not by reading the code.
change: Every refusal a miner door raises before the SDK carries the SDK's registered correction for the same request, not a bare code.
Test gap closed: dry_validate was only tested on structurally broken strategies, never against the submission compile's verdict on the same strategy.
